caption:
A missed call and a form fill are not the same lead.

They don't want the same response either.

Four rules for matching your first reply to the channel a lead actually used:

1. Missed call -> text back first

2. Web form -> call first

3. DM or Google message -> reply in that same thread

4. Referral -> call it yourself, personally

Get this backwards and a warm lead reads your reply as generic, or worse, ignored.

Reply inside five minutes instead of letting it sit and you roughly double your shot at closing it, no matter which channel they used.

DM TRIAL

#SpeedToLead #ServiceBusiness #LeadFollowUp #CRMforContractors #LocalServiceMarketing
rationale: Carousels still win saves and depth for B2B framework content, and channel-matched first contact is a genuinely unclaimed mental model distinct from every prior stage, ladder, matrix, decay-curve, tiering, and scorecard framework shipped this cycle.
